title: AI Lyrics
description: Makes word-timed lyrics for songs that have none, or times the plain lyrics a song has. Lyrics it makes are marked as made by AI.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: On This Device keeps the song on this device. Online sends the song's audio to your provider, after you allow it, with your own API key; the provider's terms and prices apply.

model.title: Model
model.description: Larger models recognise singing better and take longer. The model is downloaded once, when you ask for it.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Where the audio goes in the Online mode. Custom is a server that speaks OpenAI's speech-to-text API, such as one you run yourself.

server_url.title: Server Address
server_url.description: For Custom: the address of the API, up to and including its version, for example http://192.168.1.20:8000/v1.

online_model.title: Model
online_model.description: Leave empty for the provider's model with word timing: whisper-1 at OpenAI, whisper-large-v3-turbo at Groq, whisper-1 on a Custom server.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language sung. Detect lets the model decide, or uses the language of the song's lyrics when it is known.

automatic.title: Create Automatically
automatic.description: Makes lyrics for each song that starts playing without synced lyrics. In the Online mode every such song is sent to your provider.
